quest.title: Kurious Kamera
quest.description: A certain special Kamera is currently causing Ji Tong some grief...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Kurious Kamera x1

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: How very strange... What is the matter with this Kamera?

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: I think it's broken... Well, maybe not broken, but it's certainly not working like it's supposed to.

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: I ordered a batch from Fontaine a while back.

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: The person who sold it to me said that this particular kind of Kamera features the very latest technology from Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: Supposedly, it can print photos in a special hue and add in some special effects, or something. So I bought one to try it out.

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: But try as I might, I can't get it to print out photos properly. I don't know whether I'm using it wrong, or if it's just faulty.

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: Maybe there's some trick to it that I'm not getting...

dialogues.speaker: Ji Tong
dialogues.text: So, how about you? Much of a Kamera Konnoisseur yourself?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I'll take that as a yes! So, could I get you to help?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: I'm guessing you're a traveler? You must have a lot of experiences under your belt.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: What I'd like you to do is use this Kamera to take a picture of something with a strong color.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Once you've taken a snap, if you could please bring me the photo. I want to see if I can isolate the source of the issue...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: And if I can't, I'll take the photos to the seller and see what he has to say. With the photos as hard evidence, he won't be able to dismiss the issue.

choices.text: What do you mean by strong color?

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Oh, you know... Really bright colors, like red Jueyun Chilis, blue Mist Flower...

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Once you've taken a good shot, bring me the photo.

choices.text: Never heard of a "Kamera" in my life.

response.speaker: Ji Tong
response.text: Oh, I see... Well, never mind, it's simple enough to use... Would you mind giving me a hand anyway?
